direction_count.note: a study resolving every contested choice the same way is how a lean survives an audit of its steps. This is a flag and not a failure: a company can genuinely deserve a consistent read.

judgements.name: the asset yield through the rate cycle
judgements.adopted: the yield falls with the administered policy path
judgements.alternative: fifty basis points less of decline than the path implies
judgements.why: this is the largest single lever in the study, and it is a claim about how fast a central bank finishing a disinflation lets lending rates fall. The path is the house one; holding the yield higher is a bet on the policy stance persisting

judgements.name: the cost of funds through the same cycle
judgements.adopted: deposit costs fall with the policy path
judgements.alternative: fifty basis points more of deposit cost than the path implies
judgements.why: the other half of the margin, and it moves the answer nearly as far. A bank whose asset yield falls faster than its funding cost is the compression this study forecasts; the alternative is that competition for deposits holds funding costs up

judgements.name: the cost of risk
judgements.adopted: the charge normalises toward the disclosed through-cycle rate
judgements.alternative: fifty basis points more of provisioning, held
judgements.why: the filings disclose the charge but not the vintage behind it, so a normalisation is a judgement rather than a reading

judgements.name: the financing growth path
judgements.adopted: the disclosed run, fading toward the terminal
judgements.alternative: five points a year less across the whole window
judgements.why: credit deepening in an economy whose private credit is about a quarter of GDP is real and it is also finite; the window's own end is the open item this study's macro record declares
